gloss: good mood; high spirits; good humor

definitions.gloss: good mood; high spirits; good humor
definitions.explanation: A state of being in a cheerful, pleasant mood, often visibly so.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{上機嫌|じょうきげん}で{帰|かえ}ってきた。
examples.english: My father came home in a great mood.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{受|う}かって、{彼女|かのじょ}は{上機嫌|じょうきげん}だった。
examples.english: Having passed the exam, she was in high spirits.

examples.japanese: {上機嫌|じょうきげん}な{上司|じょうし}に{頼|たの}み{事|ごと}をするなら{今|いま}がチャンスだ。
examples.english: If you want to ask the boss a favor, now's your chance while he's in a good mood.

notes:
Describes a visibly cheerful, pleasant mood. Can be used as a noun ({上機嫌|じょうきげん}だ) or as a pre-noun modifier ({上機嫌|じょうきげん}な). The {上|じょう} prefix elevates {機嫌|きげん} (mood, humor) to its positive extreme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}で{話|はな}す — talk in good spirits
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}な{顔|かお} — cheerful face
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}に{歌|うた}う — sing happily
- ご{上機嫌|じょうきげん} — polite form, used in set phrases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {機嫌|きげん}がいい — in a good mood; more neutral and everyday than {上機嫌|じょうきげん}, which implies a noticeably elevated level of cheerfulness
- {不機嫌|ふきげん} — bad mood; the opposite of {上機嫌|じょうきげん}
- ご{機嫌|きげん} — mood (polite); also used in greetings like ご{機嫌|きげん}いかが
